New World had potential, as a lot of games do. New World also squandered that potential, also as many games do. Repetitive questing, shallow crafting, and lackluster PvP (especially in regards to open world PvP) make for a game with little reason to play. Beyond enticing graphics, this game offers nothing truly unique or groundbreaking and little to incentivize players to return and continue playing.

All of this said, normally I would not leave a review, as it’s not a BAD game, just not a good game. The breaking point however is Amazon’s recent attack on Youtuber Video Game Databank. Amazon issues a false DMCA claim on one of Databank’s videos that addressed a glitch in New World with the aim to suppress any negative press that that video may direct towards the game, despite Databank clearly being a fan of New World and merely aiming to address a bug in a game he enjoys. False DMCA claims are no joke and can ruin a Youtuber’s career, and should not be allowed nor taken lightly.

Amazon being the mega corporation it is will undoubtedly be unaffected, however we still should not spend money on a product they clearly are willing to ruin lives over supporting.

A Complete Trainwreck – Stay Far Away

New World is one of the most mismanaged, broken, and incompetent MMO disasters ever released. Amazon Game Studios has proven time and time again that they have no clue how to run an online game. Instead of fixing the countless game-breaking bugs, they apply half-baked patches that create even more issues, making the experience progressively worse. 

The customer support is a complete joke. Any appeal or complaint is met with lazy, automated responses, showing absolute disregard for the players. Unjust bans and penalties are handed out without proper investigation, while actual cheaters run rampant. The enforcement is nothing but a biased, inconsistent mess. 

Gameplay-wise, the grind is tedious, PvP is horrendously imbalanced, and PvE is uninspired and repetitive. The economy is a disaster, plagued by exploits and AGS’s sheer incompetence in managing in-game systems. Server populations are plummeting because players are sick of dealing with the same nonsense over and over again. 

New World is a sinking ship, and AGS is too clueless to fix it. Save yourself the frustration—don’t waste your time or money on this dumpster fire.

A New World!? No, just more of the same crap worlds developed for the mmo community. I beta tested. Warned that the npcs, the mythos, the world was stale boring and left you feeling like you'd just eaten Dunkin Donuts leftovers from days ago....all you could taste was the too sweet sugar they think you wanted and that bloaty feeling from pointless carbs. The sugar rush....PvP! Yeah, but its over too soon, the good stuff only available during certain peak hours, hours you might not be available to sign up for. The bloaty carbs.... mindless pve. No Razumdar from ESO. No fleshed out NPC kings and queens to fight for. Just goofy animation looping cartoons in each repetitive town. Playing New World is like being stuck in a bad version of Groundhogs Day. Just kill your toon and end it all.

The combat is slow and clunky. Rubber banding while dodging. Questing was literally killing x mobs run back to town pick up another quest gather x items and to get to quest, since there is no Mounts, you do a lot of running. Crafting is par, takes way to much material to create and low amount of exp gained to level crafting. The world is way too small compared to other MMOs. Trying to find armor/weapons at your level while leveling up is near impossible. Armor provides inappropriate benefits. Still tons of bots in the game(They get reported but still there). Limited thing to do end game, not enough content being released to enjoy. An MMO that is on a large island and lots of lakes and rivers, there is NO SWIMMING?(which means you are sluggish walking in many areas through water and most the time you cannot fight in the water because it is too deep.

If you are in the market for a mmrpg, I recommend that you do not purchase New World. The game is a shallow experience.. New World is a buggy mess that is not worth your time or money.

I'm a disabled player and a game like New World seems like it's right for me: multiplayer, numerous play options, customization, essentially a world for folks who are stuck inside. The good parts are all bog standard for MMORPGs: crafting, scenery, setting. The bad, though? Yikes.

The most immediate issue I had with the game was the controller scheme. Since I have an issue with spasticity I play with a controller. Big mistake with this game, huge. To actually use a controller, players need to pop into the overlay and pray they find the right config through Steam's awesome community. Some work, most do not. And since the game is updated so erratically it doesn't actually give one a chance to get used to literally any controller scheme. Keyboard is worse, though! What does this key do? Who knows! Just press iit!

I have over 2k hours on this game between pc and xbox. The game overall is great. Graphics and combat style are what keep me coming back to this game. If you're looking for a fast paced reach top level and top gear fast style game, then this is not for you. It is a grind, as these style of games are supposed to be. If you enjoy the grind and acquiring over time then this is fit for you! My only complaint about this game is how slow the devs are with putting out new content for end game, which in result has led to alot of the player base moving on. They do listen to the community when it comes to what needs to be fixed for the most part, it just takes them forever to do it! If they pumped out end game content or any content at a quicker pace this game would be at the top of the genre!! Overall 8/10 game.
